translated_title: Sheinbaum Kicks Off the National Reforestation Day in Puebla; the Goal Is to Plant 6.6 Million Trees
original_title: Sheinbaum arrancó en Puebla la Jornada Nacional de Reforestación; el objetivo es sembrar 6.6 millones de árboles
author: Néstor Jiménez
meta_description: Sheinbaum launched Mexico's National Reforestation Day, aiming to plant 6.6 million trees in a single day, and proposed renaming the Cortés Pass the 'Pass of the Indigenous Peoples.'
